name: Celwis
description: Celwis was a planet of the Chiss Ascendancy in the Celwis system of the Unknown Regions. It was located on the Vagaari Corridor, a hyperlane that ran through the Unknown Regions. Celwis was once regularly attacked by alien aggressors, but it eventually became a demonstration of Chiss military strength shortly after the formation of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Force.
